Name: SuperiorLuxuryAnimalRoom
Author: yangZheng20
Description:
[size=4]1.Spend 300,000 and 250,000 gold coins to upgrade the barn and chicken coop for up to 20 animals
2.It is used with my other module "StrokingAutomati" feeding, automatic feeding of animals
3.In combination with the "GenericModConfigMenu", you can choose between clean or raw maps
1、花费30万和25万金币升级畜棚和鸡舍，最多可容纳20只动物
2、它和我的另外一个模组：“StrokingAutomatic”一起工作，每天自动更换摸抚最高等级动物房的动物，并增加好感度
3、与'GenericModConfigMenu'一起使用，你可以选择修改干净或原版的地图
[color=#ffff00]If my module is useful to you, can you buy me a cup of [url=https://ko-fi.com/yangz]coffee[/url]﻿? Thank you very much!
如果我的模组对您有用，可以请我喝一杯[url=https://ko-fi.com/yangz]咖啡[/url]吗？非常感谢！[/color][/size]

Downloads.Description: You can upgrade to higher level animal houses and expand the capacity of animal houses, which you can use in conjunction with 'AutomaticStroking', which will automatically pet animals in your luxury barn
